facts.value: The retail supplement system includes Hydros in three flavors, Fortius Aqua, Restoria, Ascend, Nocturne, Solaris, Genesis, Vitalis NMN and Nexus NAD+.

The physical Sanctum is a long-term vision in development, not a construction announcement or operating clinic. The proposed destination combines grooming, community, retail, education and qualified wellness partners.

The member-app vision concerns tracking, education and preparation for professional conversations. Founding 100 is an interest list; it grants no ownership, investment return, guaranteed membership or medical services. Features and dates may change.
